requirements.requirement: Only an authenticated user of an organisation can read or create programs; an anonymous request is refused with 401/403 and no data. Interactive login is via `/concept2cure/login`; in a development install a Demo Access control may substitute the password factor and must be absent when `NODE_ENV=production`.

steps.title: Anonymous access refused
The sign-in page takes the user into the shell

ra.intendedUse: Gate every program read/write behind an authenticated organisation member
ra.risk: high — unauthenticated access would expose or alter regulated records
ra.rationale: Part 11 §11.10(d); anonymous negative test plus browser login

requirements.requirement: Program creation validates its inputs: `name` and `programType` are required, `programType` must be in the controlled vocabulary, and the product class is derived from the filing type and may not be contradicted by the client; invalid input is refused with 400 naming the field.

steps.title: Program creation validates its inputs

ra.rationale: deterministic validation, cheap to script both negatives

Program is listed and readable for the organisation

ra.risk: high — the program is the root of every downstream record

steps.title: Program creation is attributable in the activity feed and the hash-chained audit log verifies
Program creation appears on the organisation audit ledger surface

ra.intendedUse: Attribute program creation and keep it in the chained log
ra.rationale: activity feed, chain verifier, ledger surface each checked

requirements.requirement: The Projects and Project Home surfaces render the organisation's programs and the open program without runtime errors.

Projects surface renders the program

ra.rationale: rendering check with screenshot; observed state recorded

steps.title: Create a task and see it on the task board

ra.risk: medium — tasks drive but do not constitute the filing

requirements.requirement: The Program Journey read model and the Filings Catalog surface answer honestly for a new organisation (empty state or explained unavailability; never fixture data, never a silent 500).

steps.title: Program journey read model answers
Filings catalog surface renders

ra.intendedUse: Honest empty/unavailable states for journey and catalog
ra.rationale: render and record; no fixture data may appear

requirements.requirement: With launch scope enforced, the navigation payload marks every out-of-catalog surface as not entitled with source `launch-scope`, the six launch apps are entitled, and a deep link to an out-of-catalog surface renders the "not in this release" gate rather than the surface.

steps.title: Launch scope is enforced in the navigation verdicts
Deep link to an out-of-scope surface shows the launch-scope gate

ra.risk: medium — an out-of-scope surface reachable in production would expose unvalidated functions

requirements.requirement: A program id that does not belong to the caller's organisation (or does not exist) answers 404 — never 200 with another tenant's data, never 500.

steps.title: A program id the organisation does not own is not readable

ra.rationale: negative test; full RLS under D3

requirements.requirement: Every sign-in attempt by a user of an organisation is entered in that organisation's hash-chained audit log and shown on its audit ledger: a wrong password, the second-factor challenge a correct password receives, a wrong code, and the session a verified code opens. A refused attempt reads as refused, never as a sign-in.

ra.intendedUse: Enter every sign-in attempt in the organisation's audit trail
ra.risk: high — without it an attack on an account, or a session opened on it, leaves no record an inspector can read (§11.10(e)); F-19 showed the trail empty under RLS while every other check passed
ra.rationale: the attempts made by the step itself, read back on the ledger in order, hash-chained, with the server's chain verdict

steps.title: Anonymous access refused

steps.title: Ingest a PDF into the program vault

ra.intendedUse: Ingest a document with a recorded SHA-256

steps.title: Freeze is refused while a review comment is unresolved (negative case)
Freeze the settled document into an immutable snapshot

ra.intendedUse: Freeze into an immutable, hash-verified snapshot

requirements.requirement: An electronic signature requires the actor's PIN (a second component held only by the signer, enrolled and rotated only by the signer with the current PIN), a meaning from {AUTHOR, REVIEWER, APPROVER} and an intent; a wrong PIN answers 401 and an invalid meaning 400 with nothing stored; a valid signature stores signer, meaning, digest and the covered freeze version/hash and is listed with `pin_verified`.

steps.title: Enrol the signing PIN for the authenticated actor
E-signature refuses a wrong PIN and an invalid meaning
Apply a REVIEWER e-signature bound to the frozen snapshot

ra.intendedUse: PIN-based e-signature with meaning and intent; refusals; binding to the frozen snapshot
ra.rationale: wrong PIN, wrong meaning, valid signature listed with `pin_verified` and covered hash

requirements.requirement: Only a role with signing authority may apply a signature (403 `ESIGNATURE_NO_AUTHORITY` otherwise).

steps.title: Apply a REVIEWER e-signature bound to the frozen snapshot

ra.rationale: negative case needs a second identity on staging

steps.title: AI drafting fails closed when no provider is configured
AI drafting produces a governed draft candidate

ra.intendedUse: AI drafting fails closed without a provider; governed candidate with one
ra.risk: high — fabricated content in a filing
ra.rationale: provider absent locally; drafting re-executed with a PQ-passed model
